# What rust-ci.yml watches, as git pathspecs.
#
# Read by that workflow's `changes` job and by `just check-workflow-gates`,
# which is what keeps the two from drifting -- this file is the only copy.
#
# `:(glob)` stops `*` at a directory separator, so these mean what the same
# strings meant in GitHub's `paths:` before the list moved here.
:(glob)src/**
:(glob)scripts/**
:(glob)lib/**
:(glob)tests/**
:(glob)examples/**
package.json
docs/rust.md
Cargo.toml
rustfmt.toml
.github/workflows/rust-ci.yml
:(glob).github/scripts/**
.github/workflows/paths/rust-ci.txt

# `build.rs` compiles into every build and was missing from the list this file
# replaces: a commit touching only it ran no Rust CI at all. `Cargo.lock` is
# tracked and pins every dependency version, so a change to it changes what is
# built even when no source moves.
build.rs
Cargo.lock
